The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-warsnotmakeonegreat-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-135-Wars_Not_Make_One_Great.png]]); both show this text. * '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. During battles where your Jedi is present, players may not draw more than two battle destiny. During your turn, may ▲ Inner Strength. [Immune to Alter]” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (the ▲ written out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”).<ref name="cl-1220_136-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wars Not Make One Great (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “During your turn” to “Once during your turn” (slip marked E): “Deploy on table. During battles where your Jedi is present, players may not draw more than two battle destiny. Once during your turn, may ▲ Inner Strength. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 24 July 2013, effective immediately, from the Competitive Balance Team<ref name="pcforum-p823692">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 24 July 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p823692 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then (the Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014).
